claude_proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.targeted_by_spell
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current reaction-trigger grammar cannot express a generic incoming spell filtered by targeting shape rather than a named spell or post-save event.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to absorb a spell that is targeting only you and doesn't create an area of effect

claude_proposed_widenings.name: absorbed_spell_energy_reservoir
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The rod needs item state for both current stored energy and irreversible lifetime absorbed total, which a plain charge pool cannot model honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The rod can absorb and store up to 50 levels of energy over the course of its existence. Once the rod absorbs 50 levels of energy, it can't absorb more.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: store_triggering_spell_energy
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Canceling the triggering spell is expressible, but adding the triggering spell's cast level into item storage is not represented by any existing effect atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The absorbed spell's effect is canceled, and the spell's energy—not the spell itself—is stored in the rod. The energy has the same level as the spell when it was cast.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: substitute_stored_energy_for_spell_slot
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The rod does not grant named spells; it lets the wielder cast arbitrary prepared/known spells by paying with stored rod energy instead of spell slots.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can convert energy stored in it into spell slots to cast spells you have prepared or know

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.nonmagical_when_depleted_after_lifetime_cap
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Existing destruction policies do not cover the rod's compound terminal state: unable to absorb more and empty of stored energy.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A rod that can no longer absorb spell energy and has no energy remaining becomes nonmagical.
